fact: The May 2025 SASPP technical paper states Jigiséméjiri established a management information system and a unified social registry now holding data on over 1.4 million households, used by several programmes as a common targeting tool, and delivered transfers by mobile money (Orange Money cash-out) in Koulikoro, Mopti and Timbuktu.
title: Mali's Jigiséméjiri Project: Reflecting on the Past to Shape the Future Amid Fragility, Conflict, and Violence
publisher: World Bank, SASPP Technical Paper Series
